tests.title: Nostr discovery handler advertises sidecar-first public bootstrap fields
tests.description: Extend the existing sidecar-capability projector test to assert the full approved public bootstrap contract, including browser bootstrap fields, `relay_read_models`, service-pubkey presence in a service-key configuration, and the non-use of raw `nostr.relays` as the approved browser bootstrap surface.
preconditions: System handler can be exercised with sidecar enabled and Nostr publication enabled.
A service-key-backed configuration is available for the service-pubkey assertion.
steps: Construct a sidecar-enabled system config with publish enabled and a service key.
Call `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)` through the projector test.
Assert `browser_relays`, `sidecar_url`, `relay_sidecar`, `relay_read_models`, `service_pubkey`, and absence of approved browser-bootstrap reliance on raw `nostr.relays`.
tests.expected_result: The handler advertises the full sidecar-first public bootstrap contract for the approved slice.
fixtures: Deterministic config with sidecar enabled, publish enabled, browser relays configured, and a fixed private key.
data_requirements: Stable public relay URL such as `ws://localhost:3000/relay`.
Deterministic service private key for derived pubkey assertions.
determinism_notes: Pure projector test; no live relay or clock sensitivity beyond fixed config inputs.

tests.title: Nostr discovery handler conditionally advertises control-plane kinds and legacy false flags
tests.description: Reuse the existing projector tests that verify enabled versus disabled control-plane capability advertisement, MCP async-correlation advertisement, and explicit `false` legacy feature flags.
preconditions: System projector test suite can run with optional features toggled on and off.
steps: Run the projector tests for enabled and disabled optional feature configurations.
Inspect `control_plane` maps and legacy feature flags.
tests.expected_result: Enabled payloads advertise only enabled capability surfaces, disabled payloads omit them, and legacy fail-closed flags remain explicit `false` values.
fixtures: Default config with LLM/MCP toggled in test cases.
data_requirements: Deterministic handler configs for enabled and disabled branches.
determinism_notes: Pure projector tests with no network dependency.

tests.title: Nostr discovery store caches, deduplicates concurrent loads, and force reloads
tests.description: Reuse the existing system-store unit suite that proves one-shot caching, concurrent-load deduplication, and force reload behavior.
preconditions: The API client is mocked deterministically.
steps: Load Nostr discovery twice sequentially.
Load Nostr discovery concurrently from two callers.
Force reload after an initial load.
tests.expected_result: Normal loads reuse cached data and concurrent callers share one fetch; force reload replaces cached state with a fresh response.
fixtures: Mock Nostr discovery payloads with stable feature and Nostr fields.
data_requirements: Stable mock payloads for original and forced reload responses.
determinism_notes: No live network; promise-resolution order is controlled in test.

tests.title: Control-plane store bootstraps from advertised relays, waits for EOSE, and applies canonical relay state
tests.description: Reuse the existing control-plane store unit test that resolves browser relays from Nostr discovery, connects the shared Nostr client, opens a scoped read-model subscription, applies bootstrap EVENT callbacks before EOSE, and marks live only after every connected bootstrap relay sends EOSE.
preconditions: Mock Nostr client supports deterministic `connect` and scoped `subscribe` behavior with injectable EVENT and EOSE callbacks.
steps: Bootstrap the control-plane store from a deterministic Nostr discovery payload.
Assert relay resolution, connection, scoped subscription filters, immediate EVENT application, EOSE gating from each connected relay, and populated shared state.
tests.expected_result: Bootstrap applies canonical state during subscription catch-up, remains `syncing` until every connected bootstrap relay sends EOSE, then resolves and reaches `live`.
fixtures: Mock Nostr events for service registry, environment registry, service state, worker ad, and optional LLM/state events.
data_requirements: Deterministic browser relay URL and Bahia service pubkey.
Replaceable events with stable ids, kinds, tags, and created_at values.
determinism_notes: EVENT and EOSE are simulated through captured subscription callbacks before awaiting bootstrap resolution, not sleeps or timers.

tests.title: Dashboard and events pages render relay-backed state after system discovery bootstrap
tests.description: Reuse the existing Playwright smoke test that bootstraps from a mocked `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)` payload and renders relay-backed dashboard and events-page state from Nostr mock data.
preconditions: Browser E2E harness can mock `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)` and WebSocket relay traffic before app mount.
steps: Install E2E Nostr discovery and Nostr-event mocks.
Visit the dashboard and events page.
Assert rendered counts, relay status, activity, and discovered relay URL.
tests.expected_result: The browser reflects relay-backed state and live activity sourced from the discovered bootstrap payload and mocked relay stream.
fixtures: Mock Nostr event list for services, environments, state, workers, and activity.
mocks: Playwright route for `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)`.
data_requirements: Stable relay URL and Bahia service pubkey.
determinism_notes: Harness delivers stored events followed by explicit EOSE, so no sleep-based waiting is required.

tests.title: Control-plane bootstrap fails closed on missing capability, missing browser URLs, and connection failure
tests.description: Extend the existing bootstrap-failure coverage beyond connection failure to explicitly cover `relay_read_models=false` and no-advertised-browser-bootstrap-URL cases.
preconditions: The control-plane store can be exercised with custom mocked Nostr discovery payloads and Nostr connection outcomes.
steps: Attempt bootstrap with `relay_read_models=false`.
Attempt bootstrap with no `browser_relays` and no `sidecar_url`.
Attempt bootstrap with a valid payload but a Nostr client that never reaches connected state.
tests.expected_result: Each case returns a deterministic bootstrap failure and leaves the store in a non-ready error state.
fixtures: Mock Nostr discovery payloads for missing capability and missing browser-bootstrap fields.
mocks: Mock shared Nostr client connect state.
data_requirements: Stable failure strings for assertion or equivalent structured failure reasons.
determinism_notes: All negative cases are locally simulated; no live relay needed.

tests.title: Control-plane store enforces latest-wins/tombstones and rejects spoofed canonical Bahia events
tests.description: Reuse the existing store tests that verify replaceable latest-wins semantics, tombstone removal, and canonical-author rejection for spoofed Bahia and LLM events.
preconditions: The store has already discovered a Bahia service pubkey.
steps: Apply older, stale, newer, tombstone, and replayed replaceable events.
Apply spoofed canonical events from non-service authors.
tests.expected_result: Only newest valid canonical events remain visible, tombstones remove deleted entities, and spoofed canonical events do not mutate state.
fixtures: Deterministic replaceable and spoofed event objects.
data_requirements: Stable `created_at`, `d` tags, and service pubkeys for replaceable identity comparisons.

tests.title: Bootstrap connection status reacts to disconnect and reconnect events
tests.description: Reuse the existing connection-state unit test that toggles the shared Nostr client connection store after bootstrap and verifies live/disconnected/reconnected state transitions.
steps: Set shared Nostr client state to disconnected.
Set shared Nostr client state back to connected.
tests.expected_result: The store status changes to `disconnected` and back to `live`, incrementing the reconnect counter after bootstrap.
mocks: Mock shared Nostr client connection store.
data_requirements: Stable bootstrap success path before toggling the connection store.
determinism_notes: Pure store-state test; no relay timing dependency.

tests.title: Operator relay resolution respects precedence and fails when discovery has no browser bootstrap URLs
tests.description: Extend the existing CLI precedence tests to add the missing negative branch where `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)` is consulted but provides no `browser_relays` or `sidecar_url`, which should yield the deterministic discovery error.
preconditions: CLI relay resolution is exercised with explicit-flag, environment, and discovery-only configurations.
steps: Run the existing precedence branches for flag, environment, and discovery fallback.
Add a discovery-only branch with empty browser bootstrap fields.
tests.expected_result: Existing precedence is preserved and the discovery-only empty-bootstrap case fails deterministically.
fixtures: Fake Nostr discovery client with configurable browser-relay and sidecar fields.
data_requirements: Stable relay URL strings for flag, environment, and discovery branches.
determinism_notes: Pure CLI/unit path with mocked Nostr discovery client.

tests.title: Encrypted capability gating is explicit and not implied by public bootstrap metadata
tests.description: Refine the existing encrypted transport unit coverage so it maps to the approved AC wording: public bootstrap metadata alone must not imply encrypted capability, while explicit encrypted capability indicators still enable the encrypted path without describing that as a relay category.
preconditions: Encrypted transport helper can be exercised with public-only and explicit-encrypted-capability discovery payloads.
steps: Evaluate encrypted availability using a public-bootstrap-only Nostr discovery payload.
Evaluate encrypted availability using a payload with explicit encrypted capability indicators.
Confirm public bootstrap metadata is insufficient by itself.
tests.expected_result: Public bootstrap metadata alone does not make encrypted capability available; explicit encrypted capability inputs do.
fixtures: Nostr discovery payload with only public bootstrap fields.
Nostr discovery payload with explicit encrypted capability indicators.
data_requirements: Stable service pubkey and deterministic capability-bearing payloads.
determinism_notes: No live messaging path required; helper behavior is locally evaluated.

tests.title: One canonical Nostr discovery payload satisfies public browser bootstrap, encrypted capability gating, and operator CLI discovery
tests.description: Use one canonical Nostr discovery fixture across browser and CLI consumers: `web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js` bootstraps the shared control-plane store from the fixture, `web/tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js` proves encrypted capability gating from the same payload, and `cmd/cli/operator_nostr_test.go` serves the same fixture through the real `canonical ContextVM discovery events (kinds 11316-11320) plus NIP-51 relay sets (kind 30002)` client path to prove operator relay discovery coherence.
preconditions: A canonical Nostr discovery fixture is available with sidecar-first public bootstrap fields, a service pubkey, explicit encrypted capability indicators, and enabled optional capabilities.
steps: Feed the same Nostr discovery payload into the browser Nostr discovery consumer, control-plane bootstrap helper, encrypted capability helper, and CLI relay discovery path.
Assert each consumer derives only the approved fields and behaviors from that one payload.
tests.expected_result: All major consumers interpret the same payload coherently without relying on out-of-band discovery assumptions.
fixtures: Canonical Nostr discovery JSON fixture shared across browser and Go tests.
mocks: Mock browser Nostr client for control-plane bootstrap helper path.
Mock auth helpers for encrypted helper import.
httptest server returning the canonical Nostr discovery payload for CLI discovery.
data_requirements: Single stable payload covering public bootstrap fields, service pubkey, encrypted capability indicators, and control-plane kinds.
determinism_notes: Fixture-driven proof only; no live relays or live backend services are contacted.

tests.title: Raw `nostr.relays` fallback is not accepted as approved bootstrap proof
tests.description: Add a release-gate manual/contract check that the approved slice is satisfied only by sidecar-first bootstrap behavior and not by sidecar-disabled raw `nostr.relays` fallback. This remains blocked until the implementation cleanup tracked in `bahia-u6e1` lands.
preconditions: A sidecar-disabled Nostr discovery configuration exists for comparison.
The cleanup issue for raw `nostr.relays` exposure has either landed or is explicitly being evaluated.
steps: Compare the approved AC set against a sidecar-first configuration and a sidecar-disabled raw-`nostr.relays` configuration.
Verify that only the sidecar-first path is accepted as proof for this slice.
tests.expected_result: Sidecar-first bootstrap is the only approved success path for the slice; raw `nostr.relays` fallback is rejected as equivalent proof.
fixtures: Documented sidecar-first payload and sidecar-disabled comparison payload.
data_requirements: Reference to follow-up issue `bahia-u6e1` for current divergence.
determinism_notes: This is a manual release-gate check because the implementation currently diverges from the approved contract.

implementation_notes: The discovery slice is now fully covered by deterministic handler, store, encrypted-helper, CLI, and relay-backed smoke tests.
The canonical cross-consumer fixture in test/fixtures/system_discovery_sidecar_first.json is reused across browser and Go tests to keep the shared discovery contract coherent.
Verification still relies on deterministic mocks and the existing controlplane relay smoke harness rather than live external relays or backend services.
